sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE GREAT LAKES WILL SHIFT EAST AND REACH WEST QUEBEC BY EARLY MON...AS AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE DIGS ACROSS THE PRAIRIE PROVINCES INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST. A SURFACE CYCLONE WILL DEEPEN AS IT TRACKS FROM THE CENTRAL GREAT LAKES TOWARDS JAMES BAY. IN THE SOUTHWEST...A MID-LEVEL RIDGE SHOULD DAMPEN.

sections.title: NEW YORK TO GEORGIA
sections.text: WILL MAINTAIN ENHANCED RISK THIS OUTLOOK WITH OVERALL SCENARIO REMAINING PREDICATED ON POCKETS OF AMPLE INSOLATION AMID POOR MID/UPPER-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS WILL BE PERVASIVE FROM CENTRAL NEW YORK ON SOUTH. THIS SHOULD YIELD A MARGINALLY TO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WHERE ROBUST DIABATIC HEATING OCCURS...MOST LIKELY SOUTH OF THE MASON-DIXON LINE. AS THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AXIS APPROACHES THE NORTHERN APPALACHIANS DURING THE AFTERNOON...A BROAD BELT OF MODERATE TO STRONG 700-500 MB WEST-SOUTHWESTERLIES WILL OVERSPREAD THE WARM SECTOR...YIELDING 30-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR. STORMS SHOULD INITIATE MIDDAY ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS AND SPREAD EAST OVER THE PIEDMONT/COASTAL PLAIN INTO THE EVENING. VEERED LOW-LEVEL FLOW SHOULD LIMIT HODOGRAPH CURVATURE...BUT GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...ACTIVITY SHOULD EVOLVE INTO MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND ONE OR MORE QLCS/S. THIS SUGGESTS THAT DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...BUT A BRIEF TORNADO AND/OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES GIVEN THE DEGREE OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE.

sections.title: SOUTHERN ROCKIES
sections.text: STRONG DIABATIC HEATING WITH RECYCLED BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE /CHARACTERIZED BY MIDDLE 40S TO LOWER 50S SURFACE DEW POINTS/ SHOULD RESULT IN WEAK BUOYANCY DEVELOPING AT PEAK HEATING. AS THE MID-LEVEL RIDGE WANES...A BELT OF MODEST NORTH/NORTHWESTERLIES SHOULD OVERSPREAD THIS CORRIDOR OF WEAK BUOYANCY. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS SHOULD FORM OVER THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS AND VICINITY. MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND MAY OCCUR WITH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS.

sections.title: NORTHEAST MN TO WI
sections.text: A BELT OF STRONG MID-LEVEL NORTHWESTERLIES WILL BE PREVALENT ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST...YIELDING ELONGATED STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS THIS AFTERNOON. BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE WILL BE LIMITED AND BUOYANCY MAY REMAIN MEAGER. HOWEVER...STEEPENING TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AMID MID-LEVEL DCVA SHOULD YIELD WIDELY SCATTERED CONVECTION. SETUP MAY SUPPORT FAST-MOVING CELLS WITH SPORADIC INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. ..GRAMS/LEITMAN.. 06/05/2016

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE GREAT LAKES WILL SHIFT EAST-NORTHEASTWARD AND REACH WESTERN QUEBEC BY EARLY MONDAY...AS AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE DIGS SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE PROVINCES INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST. A SURFACE CYCLONE WILL DEEPEN AS IT TRACKS FROM THE CENTRAL GREAT LAKES TOWARDS JAMES BAY. IN THE SOUTHWEST...AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE WILL DAMPEN AHEAD OF A SLOW-MOVING UPPER LOW OVER NORTHERN CA/NV.

sections.title: EASTERN STATES
sections.text: STRENGTHENING MID/HIGH-LEVEL CYCLONIC FLOW IS EXPECTED TODAY OVER MUCH OF THE MID-ATLANTIC/NORTHEAST STATES TODAY IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING OVER THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TOWARD QUEBEC. A COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE GENERALLY EASTWARD TODAY ACROSS THE MIDDLE/UPPER OH RIVER VALLEY...REACHING THE COASTAL NORTHEAST/MID-ATLANTIC STATES BY EARLY MONDAY MORNING. AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...A MOIST AIR MASS WILL CONTINUE TO ADVECT NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC/NORTHEAST STATES...WITH UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS INCREASINGLY COMMON AS FAR NORTH AS NY/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. WHILE RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE WILL INCREASINGLY BE IN PLACE...EARLY-MORNING SATELLITE/RADAR IMAGERY FEATURES RELATIVELY PREVALENT CLOUD COVER AND WIDELY SCATTERED SHOWERS WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR...WITH WEAK LAPSE RATES NOTED IN REGIONAL 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS. THIS CASTS SOME UNCERTAINTY ON THE EXACT DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON...BUT EVEN SO...POCKETS OF STRONG INSOLATION AND A MARGINALLY TO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS SHOULD LEAD TO INTENSIFYING/INCREASINGLY SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON. WITH A STRENGTHENING BELT OF MID-LEVEL /700-500 MB/ WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY WIN

sections.title: CO/NM
sections.text: A SUBTLE MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE OVER SOUTHWEST WY IN THE PREDAWN HOURS SHOULD CONTINUE SOUTHEASTWARD AND REACH CENTRAL CO/NORTHERN NM THIS AFTERNOON. RELATED FORCING FOR ASCENT/OROGRAPHIC EFFECTS SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO A STEADY INCREASE OF THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A MODESTLY MOIST ENVIRONMENT /MIDDLE 40S TO LOWER 50S F DEWPOINTS/. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS SHOULD INITIALLY FORM OVER THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON...AND SUBSEQUENTLY SPREAD SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD. AS MUCH AS 35 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUSTAINED MULTICELLS AND POSSIBLY A WEAK SUPERCELL OR TWO...WITH SEVERE HAIL/LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS A POSSIBILITY THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: EAST/NORTHEAST MN AND WI
sections.text: A STRENGTHENING BELT OF MID/HIGH-LEVEL NORTHWESTERLIES WILL BE PREVALENT ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST...YIELDING ELONGATED STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS THIS AFTERNOON. BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE WILL BE LIMITED /40S TO LOWER 50S F DEWPOINTS/ AND BUOYANCY MAY REMAIN MEAGER. HOWEVER...STEEPENING LOW/MID-TROPOSPHERIC LAPSE RATES AMID MID-LEVEL DCVA SHOULD YIELD WIDELY SCATTERED LOW-TOPPED THUNDERSTORM-PRODUCING CONVECTION. SETUP MAY SUPPORT FAST-MOVING CELLS WITH SPORADIC INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: NORTHERN CA/NV INTO ORE/ID
sections.text: AN UPPER LOW OVER NORTHERN CA EARLY THIS MORNING WILL CONTINUE TO DRIFT EAST-NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD NORTHERN/CENTRAL NV THROUGH TONIGHT. RELATED DPVA/UPPER-JET EXIT REGION WILL OVERSPREAD NORTHERN PORTIONS OF CA/NV INTO SOUTHERN/EASTERN ORE AND SOUTHERN ID...WITH AN EXPECTED DIURNAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORMS WITHIN A RELATIVELY MOIST ENVIRONMENT /0.50-0.70 INCH PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES/. WHILE LOW/MID-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW WILL BE WEAK /LESS THAN 25 KT/ ON THE NORTH-NORTHEAST PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER LOW...SUFFICIENT MOISTURE/STEEP LAPSE RATES AND WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD SUPPORT SOME DOWNBURST POTENTIAL /AND POSSIBLY SMALL HAIL/ THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. ..GUYER/DEAN.. 06/05/2016

sections.text: A COMPLEX CONVECTIVE SCENARIO WILL UNFOLD THROUGH TONIGHT AS AN UPPER SHORT WAVE TROUGH FROM NORTHWEST ONTARIO INTO LOWER MI ROTATES EWD/NEWD ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION AND NEW ENGLAND...AS A BROAD UPPER LOW REMAINS OVER ERN ONTARIO AND WRN QUEBEC. A DEEP LAYER OF SWLY FLOW ALOFT OVER THE ERN STATES IS FORECAST TO STRENGTHEN THIS AFTERNOON. PREFRONTAL MORNING CLOUDS AND GENERALLY WEAK CONVECTION HAVE BEEN WIDESPREAD ACROSS THE NORTHEAST STATES AND THIS EXTENDS SOUTHWARD ALONG THE APPALACHIANS LIMITING DIURNAL HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION. HOWEVER...VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES BREAKS IN CLOUDS DEVELOPING FROM MD AND VA SOUTHWARD INTO THE PIEDMONT REGION WITH MORE LIMITED CLOUDS FROM SERN VA INTO ERN SC. IT IS WITHIN THIS REGION THAT MORE FOCUSED DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON WITH MUCAPE REACHING 2000-2500 J/KG. CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODELS INDICATE THAT CLUSTERS OF STORMS WILL INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF CURRENT CONVECTION CROSSING THE APPALACHIANS FROM PA SWWD INTO ERN TN/EXTREME WRN NC. MULTIPLE QLCS SEGMENTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT /35-45 KT IN THE LOWEST 6 KM AGL/ TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED SEVERE CONVECTIVE

sections.title: PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE DAY 1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK
sections.text: /1/ THE ENH AREA HAS BEEN EXTENDED NWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN NJ...NERN PA...AND THE NEW YORK CITY AREA. SFC OBSERVATIONS AND VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGEST THAT A WARM FRONT CONTINUES TO SLOWLY ADVANCE NWD ACROSS THIS AREA...AND WILL CONTINUE TO DO SO GIVEN SFC PRESSURE FALLS AROUND 2 MB PER 2 HRS TO ITS N. THIS BOUNDARY IS FORECAST TO EXTEND FROM FAR NERN PA TO FAR NRN NJ TO THE NYC AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON...AND WILL SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. MOIST SLY FLOW WITH DEWPOINTS AROUND 70F AND RELATED INSTABILITY NEAR/S OF THE BOUNDARY WILL FOSTER INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION PRESENTLY SPREADING ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL PA/MD. THIS IS ESPECIALLY THE CASE GIVEN THE APPROACH OF STRONGER MID-LEVEL FLOW/ASCENT ATTENDANT TO AN UPSTREAM VORT MAX. THIS WILL ALLOW THE SVR-WIND RISK TO BUILD NEWD TOWARD THE WARM FRONTAL ZONE...FORECAST TO EXTEND SLIGHTLY TO THE N THAN PREVIOUSLY ANTICIPATED. THE RISK FOR A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO WILL ALSO EXIST IN PROXIMITY TO THE WARM FRONT...AS THE OKX VWP SAMPLES ABUNDANT LOW-LEVEL SPEED/DIRECTIONAL SHEAR...AND SUCH TORNADO POTENTIAL WOULD BE GREATEST WITH ANY SUSTAINED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AND/OR MESOVORTICES EMBEDDED IN QLCS SEGMENTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY POSE A RISK FOR A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THROUGH 1530Z OVER SE LOWER MI INCLUDING THE DETROIT METRO AREA. WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING A LINE OF STORMS WITH A FEW EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS IS MOVING AT 30-35 KT INTO SERN LOWER MI. THESE STORMS ARE DEVELOPING IN ASSOCIATION WITH A ZONE OF DEEP ASCENT/DCVA ACCOMPANYING A VORTICITY MAXIMUM ROTATING THROUGH BASE OF THE SYNOPTIC TROUGH. A 40 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY REPORTED AT FLINT MI. SOME DESTABILIZATION OF THE DOWNSTREAM BOUNDARY LAYER WILL OCCUR DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS WHICH MAY FURTHER INCREASE THE THREAT FOR A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS BEFORE STORMS MOVE EAST OF THE STATE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY POSE A RISK FOR A FEW INSTANCES OF DOWNBURST WINDS AND HAIL INTO THE AFTERNOON. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG DIABATIC WARMING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER WITH LOW 60S F DEWPOINTS HAS CONTRIBUTED TO MODEST INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF OH WITH MLCAPE FROM 500-1000 J/KG...BUT WITH WEAK /AOB 6 C/KM 700-500 MB/ LAPSE RATES. DESTABILIZATION OF THE WEAKLY CAPPED WARM SECTOR AND DEEPER FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDING A VORTICITY MAXIMUM ROTATING THROUGH BASE OF UPPER TROUGH HAS CONTRIBUTED TO SEVERAL BANDS OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS FROM ERN IND INTO WRN OH. BELT OF STRONGER /40-50 KT/ WINDS AT 500 MB IS RESULTING IN 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SUGGESTING A FEW STORMS MIGHT DEVELOP MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION. PRIMARY MITIGATING FACTORS ARE WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND LIMITED NEAR-SFC CONVERGENCE MECHANISMS. HOWEVER...STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT SOME RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN INTENSITY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS THE MID ATLANTIC REGION. BOTH LINE SEGMENTS AND SUPERCELLS WILL DEVELOP WITH DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREAT...BUT SOME HAIL A COUPLE TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS DEPENDING ON CONVECTIVE TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THINNING CIRRUS SHIELD IS PROMOTING DIABATIC HEATING EAST OF THE APPALACHIANS FROM VA NWD INTO SCNTRL PA. DUE TO THE PRESENCE OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH NEAR 70F DEWPOINTS...THE ATMOSPHERE WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE DESPITE WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. BAND OF CONVECTION FROM WV THROUGH WCNTRL PA IS EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY AS IT CROSSES THE APPALACHIANS AND INTERACTS WITH THE DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER. A BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ACCOMPANYING THE PROGRESSIVE SYNOPTIC TROUGH HAS OVERSPREAD WARM SECTOR...WITH VWPS INDICATING 40-45 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR IN THIS REGION. DISCRETE CELLS SHOULD ALSO INITIATE AHEAD OF THE LINE DUE TO WEAK CONVECTIVE INHIBITION...AND SOME OF THESE WILL LIKELY DEVELOP UPDRAFT ROTATION. 0-1 KM HODOGRAPHS ARE RELATIVELY SMALL DUE TO VEERED LOW-LEVEL WINDS. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE DAMAGING WIND WITH THE LINEAR MODES...BUT SOME HAIL AND AT LEAST A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH THE MORE DISCRETE ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON WITH ISOLATED INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL AREA OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED ACROSS THE MINNESOTA ARROWHEAD EARLY THIS AFTERNOON...ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF LARGER-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH AN UPPER-LEVEL IMPULSE EMBEDDED WITHIN STRENGTHENING NORTHWEST FLOW ALOFT. DESPITE LOWER 50S SURFACE DEW POINTS...STRONG INSOLATION AND MID-LEVEL COOLING WILL RESULT IN WEAK SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON. LONG/STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS WILL RESULT IN ORGANIZED STORMS...POSSIBLY WITH MID-LEVEL ROTATION SUPPORTIVE OF LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS AS STORMS MOVE RAPIDLY SOUTHEAST. THE OVERALL SEVERE RISK SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON. BOTH MULTICELLS AS WELL AS SOME SUPERCELLS ARE EXPECTED WITH DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREAT...THOUGH SOME HAIL MAY ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGER STORMS. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED BEFORE 19Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THINNING CIRRUS SHIELD HAS PROMOTED DESTABILIZATION OF THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER THIS AFTERNOON WITH LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWING 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE FROM SERN GA THROUGH THE CAROLINAS. WEAK CAP...DIFFERENTIAL HEATING AND FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WILL PROMOTE THUNDERSTORM INITIATION WITHIN THE BROAD WARM SECTOR. A BELT OF 40-50 KT WINDS IN THE 700-500 MB LAYER HAS OVERSPREAD THE WRN HALF OF WARM SECTOR SUPPORTING 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL PROMOTE BOTH MULTICELL AND SOME SUPERCELL MODES. DAMAGING WIND IS EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY RISK. WEAK MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND RELATIVELY WARM TEMPERATURES ALOFT SHOULD LIMIT OVERALL LARGE HAIL THREAT...BUT THIS WILL BE OFFSET SOMEWHAT WITHIN STORMS THAT CAN DEVELOP UPDRAFT ROTATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE STRONGER STORMS CAPABLE OF SEVERE WIND AND HAIL. STORMS MAY MERGE INTO A SOUTHEAST-MOVING COMPLEX LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR STRONG WINDS. THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS OF SOUTH-CENTRAL COLORADO/NORTH-CENTRAL NEW MEXICO EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AS DIURNAL HEATING HAS RESULTED IN WEAK SURFACE-BASED INSTABILITY. MODEST LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK MID-LEVEL IMPULSE OVER COLORADO AND UPSLOPE LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL LIKELY RESULT IN A CONTINUED INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON. THE LOW-LEVEL SOUTHERLY COMPONENT COUPLED WITH NORTHWEST FLOW ALOFT HAVE YIELDED EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES OF 25-35 KTS...SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES. STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL RESULT IN A RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND SEVERE HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. AS STORM COVERAGE INCREASES WITH TIME...A LOOSELY ORGANIZED SOUTHEAST-MOVING CLUSTER MAY ULTIMATELY AFFECT PORTIONS OF NORTHEAST/EAST-CENTRAL NEW MEXICO INTO THE EVENING HOURS WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED GIVEN THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL THROUGH 22Z FROM ERN OH INTO WRN PA. A LIMITED SEVERE THREAT MAY EXPAND A BIT FARTHER EAST BEYOND WW 235 INTO SWRN NY AND NWRN PA...BUT OVERALL THREAT DOWNSTREAM IS NOT EXPECTED TO BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR AN ADDITIONAL WW. HOWEVER...WW CAN BE LOCALLY EXTENDED AS NEEDED FARTHER EAST INTO PITTSBURGH CWA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN BAND OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CONTINUES FROM EXTREME NW PA THROUGH ERN OH MOVING EAST AT AROUND 35 KT. STRONGEST STORMS REMAIN OVER NWRN PA AND NERN OH WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS MAXIMIZED ALONG A LAKE-ENHANCED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN 40-45 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR AND SOME MID-LEVEL ROTATION HAS BEEN OBSERVED WITH SOME OF THE CELLS. ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR A FEW STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL NEXT FEW HOURS FROM ERN OH INTO EXTREME WRN NY AND WRN PA. THOUGH A LIMITED SEVERE THREAT MAY EXTEND BEYOND WW 235...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO WEAKEN WITH EWD EXTENT INTO WRN PA THROUGH WRN NY WHERE AN EXPANSIVE CLOUD SHIELD HAS RESULTED IN WEAKER INSTABILITY. ..DIAL.. 06/05/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT FEW HOURS. A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...ESPECIALLY FROM SERN PA...NJ AND EXTREME SERN NY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ORGANIZED LINE OF STORMS FROM ERN PA THROUGH NRN MD IS MOVING EAST AT AROUND 35 KT. SOME LEWP/BOWING STRUCTURES CONTINUE TO BE OBSERVED. A FEW DISCRETE CELLS HAVE ALSO DEVELOPED AHEAD OF THE LINE. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MARGINALLY TO MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE FROM NEAR 500 J/KG OVER SERN PA INTO NJ TO AROUND 1500 J/KG FARTHER SOUTH INTO VA. STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN STRONG /40-45 KT/ EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...BUT LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS REMAIN SMALL OVER MOST OF THE REGION. AN EXCEPTION IS IN VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT OVER NRN NJ WHERE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE BACKED TO SELY. THOUGH THE PRIMARY THREAT IS DAMAGING WIND...A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT AS STORMS CONTINUE EWD AND INTERACT WITH THIS BOUNDARY. ..DIAL.. 06/05/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR STORMS WITH POTENTIAL DAMAGING WIND GUSTS COULD STILL INCREASE ACROSS THE SOUTHEAST VIRGINA/NORTHEAST NORTH CAROLINA COASTAL PLAIN THROUGH 00-02Z. IT IS ANTICIPATED THAT A NEW WATCH WILL NOT BE NEEDED AFTER THE CURRENTLY SCHEDULED 03Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS A SIGNIFICANT SHORT WAVE TROUGH CONTINUES TO PIVOT NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION...ASSOCIATED LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY DISPLACED FROM THE SOUTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST REGION. IN LOWER-LEVELS...FLOW HAS BEEN MAINTAINING A SUBSTANTIAL WESTERLY COMPONENT ACROSS THE PIEDMONT INTO THE COASTAL PLAIN. AND APPRECIABLE BOUNDARY LAYER INSTABILITY HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY CONFINED TO THE SOUTHEAST VIRGINIA/NORTHEAST NORTH CAROLINA COASTAL PLAIN...WHERE APPROACHING STORMS FROM THE WEST COULD STILL INTENSIFY SOME THROUGH 00-02Z. AIDED BY POTENTIAL HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING AND DOWNWARD TRANSFER OF MOMENTUM ASSOCIATED WITH 30-40 KT DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW...STRONGER STORMS COULD BE ACCOMPANIED BY POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS BEFORE WEAKENING/SPREADING OFFSHORE BY 02-03Z. ..KERR.. 06/05/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR A BRIEF/WEAK TORNADO IS EVIDENT OFFSHORE AND EXTENDING SLIGHTLY INLAND NEAR AND S OF THE TAMPA AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR LOOP THIS MORNING CONTINUES TO REVEAL SMALL/WEAK CONVECTIVE CELLS THAT HAVE EXHIBITED SOME DEGREE OF LONGEVITY -- AND ASSOCIATED/WEAK LOW-LEVEL ROTATION -- MAINLY OFF THE FL COAST W OF THE FMY /FORT MYERS/ VICINITY. TAMPA VWP AS WELL AS THE 06Z TBW RAOB INDICATE AMPLE VEERING/SHEAR IN THE 0-1 KM LAYER TO SUPPORT THE AFOREMENTIONED LOW-LEVEL ROTATION. HOWEVER...THE RAOB ALSO REVEALS A SHALLOW/WEAKLY THERMODYNAMICALLY STABLE SURFACE-BASED LAYER AS WELL...WITH CELLS GENERALLY DECAYING RAPIDLY AS THEY MOVE INLAND OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS CONFIRMING THE THERMODYNAMIC CONCERNS INLAND. WITH THAT SAID...A MORE UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER EXISTS WITH SWD EXTENT ALONG THE COAST...AND GIVEN THE SSELY SURFACE FLOW SOME ADVECTION OF THIS HIGHER THETA-E AIR NWD COULD RESULT IN A SMALL INCREASE IN POTENTIAL FOR A CELL OR TWO TO SURVIVE INLAND. THEREFORE...A SUBTLE/GRADUAL UPTICK IN BRIEF TORNADO RISK MAY OCCUR ACROSS COASTAL AREAS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BUT ATTM EXPECT ANY RISK TO REMAIN BELOW THRESHOLDS SUPPORTIVE OF WW CONSIDERATION THROUGH AT LEAST SUNRISE.
